cases.title: Crowded list
cases.text: - **Movement:** Before moving, inspect each corridor, check adjacent doors, and decide whether the Hero can reach a safe square without passing through another figure. - Remember that a long nested explanation has less available width, so it should occupy more visual rows while keeping every continuation beneath its own text. - Attack: Choose a visible target and roll &cd-ad-r; before resolving the monster's defence. Repeat this explanation carefully so that the available card space is stressed by both larger text and inline symbols. - **Defence:** Resolve each skull, apply armour, count shields, and record lost Body Points before choosing whether to continue the encounter or withdraw through the nearest doorway. - **Search:** Check traps, treasure, hidden doors and any special quest rules. This deliberately verbose paragraph exists to consume enough space to compare the unscaled and fitted versions. - **End:** Remove temporary markers, restore any expiring effects, and hand play to the next Hero. Confirm that this final instruction remains visible or that clipping is clearly indicated. Final Check 1. Count every remaining monster. 2. Resolve every temporary effect. 3. Keep the final line visible whenever fitting permits.
visualChecks: Capture fit off and fit on on Small Artwork.
Report actual Text clipped visibility rather than assuming fit succeeds.
Compare final-line visibility and relative heading/body sizes.
futureChecks: Fitting scales indentation and text together.
All wrapped list rows count towards clipping.
No later row appears after an earlier row was clipped.
